reasons.action: The instruction explicitly asks for a new temporal motion — the car pulling forward — which overrides the frame anchor's static pose.
reasons.medium: The medium decision preserves the reference's live-action rendering; animating a still photograph does not itself authorize a medium change.
reasons.wardrobe: No clothing or accessory change is requested for any subject, so the supercar's observed attributes (carbon fibre body, orange underglow) are retained from the reference.
reasons.lighting: The request says nothing about the light, its source, direction or quality; the dark showroom lighting of the reference therefore governs.
reasons.framing: No camera composition, shot scale, viewpoint or camera movement is specified — 'pulls forward' is subject motion, not a framing instruction — so the reference's framing governs.
reasons.palette: No scene colour palette is requested; the black body and orange underglow are incidental object colours, not a scene-wide recolouring, so the reference palette governs.
